profile.Name: Calvin
profile.Personality: Stoic, proud, and sparing with words. He answers with a nod or a stony stare and snarls back at insults.
profile.Backstory: He lives in Kopek. Hooch the Bootlegger, leader of the Hook Raiders, adopted him and passed on all his knowledge and training.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Terse; he thumps his chest, pledges his sword "one as kin", and warns a scoffer, "You'll eat those words, Battle Born."
